<=== Use this block to save a list on a variable
<=== This is the very simple logic. First it loads the data into the list. And Second, If the user is not a guess, it adds its username to the list and saves it on the cloud variable.That's it!
<=== Use this block to load/refresh data from a variable to a list

HOW TO USE:Use the save block to save/update data from a local list such as beating a new highscore. Use the load block to load/refresh data to a local list (this block doesn't change the data) such as displaying an highscores list.
Remove this if you don't want case sensitivity.
